## Scope, evidence, and interpretation

This wiki preserves supplied records through September 30, 2026, including future-effective commitments. Source IDs identify evidence, not instructions. Contract execution, subscription effectiveness, deployment go-live, ownership of record, temporary coverage, and day-to-day work are distinct concepts.

- Executed instruments establish the changes they expressly make; unchanged terms may continue from earlier instruments. Drafts, unsigned review copies, operational rosters, and reported usage are not interchangeable with signed subscription commitments. [D024–D044]
- Emails, CRM notes, meetings, tickets, and digests retain their source-specific claims even when they disagree. Later dates alone do not establish authority.
- “Account” can mean a customer relationship, software login, benefits record, vendor relationship, expense account, or narrative account of a meeting. Context matters. [D057] [D071] [D090–D092] [D104]
- Undated shorthand such as “the account Tobias runs,” “the account Dana runs,” or “the account Pree runs” is not always uniquely resolvable. Named-account context is retained below without turning every ambiguous mention into an assignment. [D013] [D100] [D103] [D109] [D117]
- Customer requests, rollout plans, weak competitive signals, and operational complaints do not independently establish buying intent, approved strategy, or an executed commercial change.

## Seller, policy, and internal roles

### Company and product

**Pemberline Systems** supplies **Pemberline Dock**, hosted yard and dock scheduling software. Described modules include gate check-in, dock assignment, carrier appointment scheduling, trailer tracking, dispatcher console, gatehouse kiosk, carrier portal, yard spotter tasking, and APIs. Edition descriptions vary by order. [D024–D030]

### Marketing, confidentiality, and commercial limits

QFL’s signed MSA permits customer marks solely in its branded carrier portal. External press releases, case studies, and public website customer lists require **prior written consent in each instance**. Pricing, the 12% discount, net pricing, operational layouts, freight volumes, and customer data are confidential under that agreement. These are QFL contractual provisions, not evidence of identical terms for every account. [D028]

The >10% CFO approval threshold appears in personnel notes and several commercial records. A larger proposed discount is not approval: QFL Amendment 2 remained draft and its 15% was rejected; BWF’s unsigned 15% redline had pending CFO approval. [D014] [D031] [D034] [D036] [D065]

### QFL contractual constraints

The signed MSA contains these account-specific provisions:

- Named-user seats, no generic/shared rotating-shift logins; permanent reassignment on termination, role transfer, or leave **over 14 consecutive days**. Expansion minimum **five seats**, executed addendum, prorated discounted rate. Original minimum commitment **140**, no seasonal/underuse refunds; later seat amendment controls quantity. [D028] [D032]
- Undisputed invoices **Net 45**; ACH/wire USD; dispute notice within **20 calendar days**, resolve in good faith within **15 business days**; late interest lower of **1.5%/month** or legal maximum from day **46**. Suspension: more than **15 days** after due date, written delinquency notice, then **10 business days** to pay. Customer PO terms rejected. [D028]
- Tier 2: Sev 1 **24×7×365**, initial human response **30 minutes**, engineering continuously engaged, hourly updates; Sev 2 Monday–Saturday **05:00–23:00 Central**, response **2 hours**, updates **4 hours**; Sev 3 weekdays **07:00–19:00**, excluding federal holidays, **8 business-hour** response; Sev 4 weekdays **08:00–17:00**, **2 business days**. [D028]
- Availability **99.5% monthly**. Scheduled maintenance Saturday **23:00–Sunday 03:00 Central**, **48-hour** status-page notice; exclusions include local devices/connectivity, third-party TMS/WMS, force majeure, contractual suspension. Credits on **1/12 annual net**, original monthly equivalent **$18,993.33**: **5%** at 99.00–99.49%, **10%** at 98.00–98.99%, **20%** below 98%. Claim within **30 days after month-end**; sole financial SLA remedy; below **97% for three consecutive months** can be material breach. [D028]
- Customer owns data; processing license limited to service/support; anonymized telemetry must not identify customer, sites, users, drivers, shipping customers or permit reverse engineering. Customer responsible for data/consents; prohibited uploads include PCI, SSNs, driver-license photos, medical certificates, regulated hazmat security plans, except standard **UN/NA four-digit** codes for yard segregation. [D028]
- CSV/JSON export during term; **30-day** read-only retrieval after end; active production deletion within following **15 days**, backups within **90 days**. [D028]
- TLS **1.2+**, AES-**256**, tenant isolation, SAML **2.0**, MFA/RBAC; annual SOC **2 Type II** examination; confidential report and penetration-test summary on request no more than annually. Confirmed security incident notice within **48 hours**; annually tested DR, continental-US redundant zones, RPO **15 minutes**, RTO **4 hours**. [D028]
- Customer-mark/public-reference restrictions appear in [Seller policy](#marketing-confidentiality-and-commercial-limits). Feedback license is perpetual/royalty-free, excluding customer confidential data from resulting updates. Competitive benchmarking, unapproved scans/load tests, resale, reverse engineering, seat-control circumvention, and malicious/unlawful use are prohibited. Customer maintains local hardware/network. [D028]
- Material performance, no material core-function/support diminution, malicious-code warranties; correction period **30 days**, then material nonconformity termination/pro-rata unused prepaid refund. No warranty of uninterrupted/error-free operation or prevention of physical accidents/detention. [D028]
- IP indemnity covers permitted-use US/Canadian IP claims; mitigation can include equivalent replacement or **30-day** termination notice/refund. Customer indemnity covers data/marks and physical injury/property damage except seller gross negligence/willful misconduct. Claim procedure requires prompt notice, defense control, assistance and unconditional release in settlements. [D028]
- Consequential/lost-profit/detention/supply-chain-delay damages excluded. General cap preceding **12 months’** net fees, initial **$227,920**; confidentiality/security disclosure super-cap **2×**, initial **$455,840**; indemnity, unpaid undisputed fees, license-restriction breaches, gross negligence/willful misconduct/fraud excluded. **Internal cross-reference error:** §13.2 labels excluded claims §13.3 and super-cap §13.4, but substantive §13.3 is super-cap and §13.4 exclusions. [D028]
- Insurance minimum insurer **A- VII**: CGL **$1m occurrence/$2m aggregate**, tech E&O/cyber **$5m claim/aggregate**, employer liability **$1m**, statutory workers’ compensation, umbrella **$3m occurrence/aggregate**; **30-day** cancellation/reduction notice. [D028]
- Automatic successive **12-month** continuation; noncontinuation written election at least **120 days** before period end. Material breach **30-day** cure; insolvency petition not dismissed within **60 days** permits closing. Rights, data return, prepaid/unpaid-fee consequences and specified survival provisions remain contractual. [D028]
- Assignment generally consent-required; affiliate/M&A exceptions require notice and written assumption, no direct software competitor assignee for customer, expansion order for excess seats. Seller remains responsible for subcontractors including Stoneharrow. Emergency security suspension minimized, notice to Thea within **2 hours**. [D028]
- Notices: personal delivery, second business day after overnight deposit, or first business day after qualifying signed-PDF email; Articles **12/16** also physical confirmation within **24 hours**. Seller `legal-notices@pemberline.example`; customer `tramaswell@quarrendonfreight.example` / `legal@quarrendonfreight.example`, copy general counsel. Illinois law/Cook County exclusive venue, jury waiver, CISG/UCITA excluded, export/FCPA compliance, independent-contractor relationship; written signed amendments required. [D028]
